Proof in the paper: The XRD peaks of RuFe@NC-900(5h) were observed at 39.48, 43.09, 45.23, 59.87, 71.62, 80.51, 85.01, and 87.39° that correspond to the (010), (002), (011), (012), (110), (013), (020), and (112) planes (Figure 2a). This confirms the formation of the Ru-Fe alloy phase (ICDD #03-065-6545) and the hexagonal crystal structure.
